tool_catalog.name: add_contact
tool_catalog.description:
Add a new contact person to contact database. Entries with identical information are allowed,
and will be assigned different person_ids.

Args:
    name:           Name of contact person
    phone_number:   Phone number of contact person
    relationship:   Optional, relationship between user and this contact
    is_self:        Optional. Defaults to False. Should be set to True if the contact corresponds to the current user.

Returns:
    String format unique identifier for the contact person, this can be passed to other functions
    which require a unique identifier for this contact person

Raises:
    DuplicateError:     When self entry already exists, and we are adding a new one
tool_catalog.signature: (name: str, phone_number: str, relationship: Optional[str] = None, is_self: bool = False) -> str

tool_catalog.name: modify_contact
tool_catalog.description:
Modify a contact entry with new information provided

Args:
    person_id:      String unique identifier for the contact person
    name:           New name for the person
    phone_number:   New phone number for the person
    relationship:   New relationship for the person
    is_self:        Optional. Defaults to False. Should be set to True if the contact corresponds to the current user.

Returns:

Raises:
    ValueError:     When all arguments were None
    NoDataError:    When the person_id cannot be found in database
    DuplicateError: When multiple entries with the same id were found
                    or when modifying an entry to self with existing self
tool_catalog.signature: (person_id: str, name: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, phone_number: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, relationship: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, is_self: Union[bool, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN) -> None

tool_catalog.name: search_contacts
tool_catalog.description:
Search for a contact person based on provided arguments

Each field has a search criteria of either
1. Exact value matching
2. Fuzzy string matching with a predefined threshold
Search results contains all contact entries that matched all criteria

Args:
    person_id:      String format unique identifier for the contact person, will be exact matched
    name:           Name of contact person, will be fuzzy matched
    phone_number:   Phone number of contact person, will be exact matched
    relationship:   Relationship between user and this contact, will be fuzzy matched
    is_self:        If the requested contact corresponds to the current user. Will be exact matched

Returns:
    A List of matching contacts. An empty List if no matching contacts were found

Raises:
    ValueError: When all arguments were not provided
tool_catalog.signature: (person_id: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, name: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, phone_number: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, relationship: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, is_self: Union[bool, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN) -> List[Dict[Literal['person_id', 'name', 'phone_number', 'relationship', 'is_self'], str]]

tool_catalog.name: search_messages
tool_catalog.description:
Search for a message based on provided arguments

Each field has a search criteria of one of the below
1. Exact value matching
2. Fuzzy string matching with a predefined threshold
3. Range matching timestamp with upperbound or lowerbound
Search results contains all contact entries that matched all criteria

Args:
    message_id:                     String format unique identifier for message, will be exact matched
    sender_person_id:               String format unique identifier for the sender, will be exact matched
    sender_phone_number:            Phone number for the sender, will be exact matched
    recipient_person_id:            String format unique identifier for the recipient, will be exact matched
    recipient_phone_number:         Phone number for the recipient, will be exact matched
    content:                        Message content, will be fuzzy matched
    creation_timestamp_lowerbound:  Lowerbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the message is created.
    creation_timestamp_upperbound:  Upperbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the message is created.


Returns:
    A List of matching messages. An empty List if no matching contacts were found

Raises:
    ValueError: When all arguments were not provided
tool_catalog.signature: (message_id: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, sender_person_id: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, sender_phone_number: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, recipient_person_id: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, recipient_phone_number: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, content: Union[str, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, creation_timestamp_lowerbound: Union[float, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN, creation_timestamp_upperbound: Union[float, tool_sandbox.common.utils.NotGiven] = NOT_GIVEN) -> List[Dict[Literal['message_id', 'sender_person_id', 'sender_phone_number', 'recipient_person_id', 'recipient_phone_number', 'content', 'creation_timestamp'], Union[str, float]]]

retrieval.query_access: query only, not recipient phone or fixture database
retrieval.ranker: existing BM25 over the same full catalog for all arms; no per-arm query rewriting or forced target seed
retrieval.training: Only original successful Fredrik repair episode; failed calls excluded; no repetition or added traces
retrieval.no_tuning: Freeze parameters, report full rankings and every arm; do not alter after outcome

execution.policy: Scripted replay of observed successful operation order search_contacts, set_cellular_service_status, send_message_with_phone_number; only tools in selected bundle may run
execution.missing_lookup: No phone supplied from hidden fixture; missing lookup prevents send
execution.missing_setter: If lookup and send available but setter absent, real upstream send is attempted and can fail
execution.other_tools: Not invoked by this restricted executor; count as unused tools
execution.setter_errors: Fixed policy attempts setter when selected, records any exception, then attempts send if phone and send tool are available. Already-enabled setter may raise on cellular-on control; do not suppress the recorded error.
execution.success: Exactly one new upstream message row to the named recipient with exact content; no external communication
execution.measurement: No autonomous-agent or full ToolSandbox benchmark claim

limits: One prospectively frozen authored continuation, not a held-out benchmark dataset
Recipient and tool catalog originate from previously inspected upstream fixtures
The executor's operation order is scripted from the observed episode, not generated by Hydra
Equal graph and local closure outcomes establish no graph quality advantage
The upstream milestone graph is not used as training evidence
